noeuds.role: Applies a constant velocity. The object moves on its own in the direction of its rotation angle.
noeuds.exemple: a projectile fired straight ahead, or a moving car.

noeuds.role: Automatically moves object A toward (or away from) object B.
noeuds.exemple: a homing missile, or a ghost following the player.

noeuds.role: Instantly cancels all chase, flee or continuous-move commands on an object.
noeuds.exemple: freeze an enemy when it is hit by an ice spell.
